Lentil and Potato Taco/Burrito
By: Isobelle
Published: Saturday, June 11, 2011 - 7:47pm

Ingredients




2 cups of cooked and drained green lentils
4 small potatoes (diced)
1 small onion (diced)
1 tablespoon of grape seed oil
For Seasoning:
1 tablespoon chili powder
3 minced garlic
1 teaspoon dried oregano
1/2 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon ground cumin
1 teaspoon sea salt (adjust to taste preference)
1 teaspoon black pepper
1 tablespoon grape seed oil
2 teaspoons vinegar

Preparation

1 Saute onions in 1 or 2 tablespoons of grape seed oil. 2 Add diced potatoes that are half cooked (either baked or boiled). 3 Cook for a few minutes until the potatoes are a bit golden or fully cooked. 4 Add cooked lentils. 5 Add seasoning. 6 Cook all together for a few minutes. 7 Build your taco or burrito using veggies: tomatoes, onions, cilantro, avocado, lettuce, etc.
